label: PF Backlog 527
title: Guard the installed /wg command copy against drift (wg_surface_check parity with pf_surface_check)
body:
## Problem / why
The installed global `/wg` copy (~/.config/opencode/command/wg.md) had DRIFTED from the checked-in source (.opencode/command_global/wg.md): same content but LF vs CRLF line endings (3116 vs 3164 bytes). `pf_surface_check.py` already guards the installed ~/.config/.../pf.md, but `wg_surface_check.py` did NOT guard wg.md, so the drift went unnoticed.

## RCCA (5-Why)
1. wg.md drifted. 2. Installed copy differed (line endings) from source. 3. No automated sync exists; the rule is 'keep byte-identical' (doc note only). 4. wg_surface_check checked only the repo-local .opencode/command/wg.md, not the checked-in command_global source nor the installed copy. 5. Guard: check content-equality (line-ending-normalized) of the installed copy vs the source.

delivery.note: wg_surface_check guards installed ~/.config/opencode/command/wg.md vs command_global source (content-equal); installed copy re-synced. merge --no-ff (no PR)

brief.problem: The installed /wg global command drifted from the source (LF vs CRLF) with no guard; pf.md had one.
brief.what_adds: wg_surface_check now verifies the installed ~/.config/.../wg.md matches the checked-in source (content-equal), parity with pf_surface_check.
brief.why: The installed command is the live one; drift means the wrong version runs.

objective: Add an installed-copy drift guard to wg_surface_check (parity with pf_surface_check): the installed ~/.config/opencode/command/wg.md must match .opencode/command_global/wg.md content-equal (line endings normalized).
acceptance_criteria: if the installed ~/.config/opencode/command/wg.md exists, it must be content-equal (line-ending-normalized)
a mismatch FAILS the gate with a 're-copy the source' message; absence is a skip (CI-safe)
out_of_scope: auto-install/refresh of global commands (separate install concern)
approach: Locate ~/.config/opencode/command/wg.md; compare bytes line-ending-normalized to .opencode/command_global/wg.md; FAIL on mismatch, skip when not installed.

prior_decisions: command_global is the installed SSOT (byte-identical rule)
divergences: none; parity with the existing pf guard

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/global_orchestrator.py, core/guardrails.py, core/run_guard.py

_note: Delivered + validated (gate OK with new drift check, lint clean)
